prompt:
Using the Flux workload manager using all available nodes and cores and the HNS simulation on a 32x32x16 grid using the in.reaxff.hns file with the -nocite flag flux option -o cpu-affinity=per-task.
The lmp binary is in /usr/local/bin. The data is in /opt/lammps-reax. Do NOT specify a queue. Set a max duration of 3m.You MUST have parameters x,y,z in the command, and you MUST use a tool to validate your lammps parameters before submit.

receipt.reasoning: The LAMMPS job was submitted to Flux. The job parameters were validated before submission. The number of tasks was reduced to 64 to avoid resource allocation errors. The job is now running.
